summary: The filing is a Form 6-K (equivalent to a U.S. domestic Form 8-K) containing a press release reporting fiscal fourth quarter and full year 2026 financial results. The registrant discusses challenging business conditions, impairment charges, and the Regent-Feinbau acquisition (closed March 1, 2026) as a strategic step. However, no new special-situation event is announced; it is a routine earnings update.
